DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 録画を見せる際に、再生の設定で確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: When showing the recording, is there anything about the playback settings you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 人が荷物を動かすのがとても速かったと説明しようとしていました。でも、携帯の早送りを使ったままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 早送り中の録画を実際の速い動作と説明しかけたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was about to explain that the person moved the luggage very quickly. But I still had fast-forward switched on on my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you nearly described a recording being fast-forwarded as an actual rapid movement. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 再生で速く見えることと、実際の動きは分けてお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please distinguish between something looking fast during playback and the person's actual movement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 探したい場面へ進むため早送りしました。元の速度で全部見たわけではないので、人が急いでいたとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的場面探しの早送りで実速度未確認と明かす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I fast-forwarded to find the scene I wanted. I have not watched the whole thing at its original speed, so I cannot say the person was in a hurry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you fast-forwarded to find a particular scene and have not checked the actual speed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の録画と、いまの再生設定は確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you check the original recording and the current playback settings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 元の録画はあります。速い映像だけを切り出して、元からその速さだったように提出するのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元録画を保有し高速部分だけを元速度として提出しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the original recording. I will not submit just a fast-looking clip as though it had originally been recorded at that speed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have the original recording and will not submit only the sped-up section as the original speed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認方法は担当が案内します。見えている動作を、ご自身で判断した気持ちと分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member responsible will explain how to check it. Please separate the visible movements from the feelings you have inferred yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物を持って通路へ出る動作は見えます。慌てて逃げたというのは私の解釈で、そのまま事実として話しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認できた運搬動作と逃走の解釈を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can see the person carrying luggage out into the passage. That they fled in a panic is my interpretation, and I will not present it as a fact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the confirmed movement of carrying the luggage from your interpretation that the person was fleeing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ、早送りで見たことを最初にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the staff member first that you watched it on fast-forward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 早送りの設定と元の録画があることを伝えます。動きの速さや理由は決めず、見えた動作の確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再生設定を先に伝え速さや動機を断定せず確認依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them about the fast-forward setting and that I have the original recording. I will ask them to check the movements that can be seen without deciding how fast the person moved or why.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Mention the playback setting first and ask for the movements to be checked without asserting their speed or motive. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 再生の設定についても担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、こちらへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will also pass the playback settings on to the staff member. Please come this way. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒には、何を入れる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What are you planning to put in this envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お祝いのカードです。開くと音が鳴りますが、紙の手紙として説明すればよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音付きカードを紙だけの手紙と説明しかけたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: A celebration card. It plays a sound when opened, but I thought I could describe it as a paper letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you nearly described a card with sound as a letter made only of paper. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 音を出す仕組みも含め、中の物が分かるようにお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell us what is inside, including the mechanism that produces the sound.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙だけではありません。カードの中に部品がありますが、種類はまだ調べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 内蔵部品があり種類は未確認と明かす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is not just paper. There are components inside the card, but I have not checked what kind yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it has built-in components whose type has not been confirmed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品の説明や表示を確認できますか。分からない部分は、未確認とお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you check the product description and labeling? Please describe anything you do not know as unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱の説明は家にあります。小さい部品だから問題ないと自分で決めず、説明を持ってきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家の説明書を持参し小さいから送れると断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The description on the box is at home. I would like to bring it in, rather than deciding for myself that the small components cannot be a problem.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will bring the instructions from home and will not assume the card can be mailed because its components are small. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その状態が分かってから、発送できる方法や条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once we know those details, we will check the available shipping methods and conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は封筒を閉じません。説明を読んだだけで送れると確定したとは考えず、改めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封をせず条件確認前の発送決定を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not seal the envelope now. I will not take merely reading the description as confirmation that it can be sent, and I will ask again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Leave the envelope unsealed and avoid deciding to send it before the conditions have been checked. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 封筒はお持ち帰りになり、必要な表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take the envelope home and check the necessary labeling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: カードと説明をそろえます。音の仕組みを外して壊すのでなく、確認できる情報を持って相談に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 仕組みを壊さずカードと説明をそろえ再相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will bring the card and its description together. Instead of removing the sound mechanism and breaking it, I will come back to ask with information that can be checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return to ask with the card and its description, without damaging the mechanism. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご準備後にご相談ください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please come and ask once you are ready. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: メモの金額は、すべて日本円で書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are all the amounts on your note written in Japanese yen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本の口座と母国の貯金を書きました。通貨の名前を省いて、数字だけを合計しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日本と母国の金額を通貨省略で合計したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote down my Japanese account and my savings in my home country. I left out the currency names and added just the numbers together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you added amounts from Japan and your home country without specifying the currencies. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通貨が違う場合、そのまま同じ単位の金額としては扱えません。どの欄がどちらの通貨ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: If the currencies differ, we cannot treat them as amounts in the same unit as they stand. Which entries use which currency?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上の二行が日本円です。下の一行は母国通貨の額で、日本円へ直した数字ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日本円二行と未換算の母国通貨一行を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The top two lines are in Japanese yen. The bottom line is an amount in my home country's currency, not a figure converted into yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the two yen entries from the one unconverted entry in your home country's currency. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの単位を示して、合計欄を見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please label each currency and revise the total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日本円と母国通貨の名前を書きます。前に見た換算の目安を、今日の確定額として付け加えるのもやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 単位を書き換算目安を当日確定額と扱わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write the names of Japanese yen and my home country's currency. I will also stop adding an approximate conversion I saw previously as though it were today's confirmed amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Label the currencies and do not treat a rough conversion as a confirmed amount for today. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在確認できる資料を分けて、相談担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show the adviser the documents you can currently verify, keeping them separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日本の口座資料は持っています。母国の額は家族から聞いたメモだけなので、資料で確認済みとも書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の口座資料と家族から聞いたメモを分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the documents for my Japanese account. For the amount in my home country, I only have a note of what my family told me, so I will not write that it has been verified with documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate your own account documents from the note of information heard from your family. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人の資料と伝え聞いた数字が分かるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please make clear which figures come from your own documents and which you heard from someone else.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通貨と情報源を分けて整理します。数字が大きいから日本円の貯金も多いと決めず、確認した範囲で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通貨と情報源を明示し数字の大きさだけで判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will organize them by currency and source. I will not assume I have a lot of savings in yen just because the number is large, and will ask for advice within the limits of what I have checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify the currencies and information sources and do not judge just by the size of the numbers. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認する項目が整理できましたね。それでは、相談担当へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have clarified what needs checking. I will take you to the adviser now. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この棚の「旬」という言葉でお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the word meaning 'in season' on this shelf?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、読み方も意味も知らなくて、この品物が今日採れたという意味かと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旬の表示を知らず当日収穫の意味か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I did not know how to read it or what it meant, and wondered whether it meant this product was harvested today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you do not know the seasonal label and ask whether it means harvested that day. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 「しゅん」と読みます。季節の食材の紹介に使う言葉ですが、今日採れたという表示ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is read 'shun.' It is used to introduce seasonal ingredients, but it does not indicate that they were harvested today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 季節の紹介なのですね。ひとつひとつの収穫日を、この文字だけで読んだつもりにならないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 季節の紹介と個々商品の収穫日を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it introduces seasonal food. I will be careful not to assume that this word alone tells me the harvest date of each item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish an introduction to seasonal food from the harvest date of individual products. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どのようなお料理をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: What kind of dish are you thinking of making?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今月の夕食に一品増やしたいです。いつもの材料だけでなく、この棚から料理に合う物を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今月の料理に合う食材探しとして選び方を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to add a dish to my dinners this month. Instead of only using my usual ingredients, I would like to choose something from this shelf that suits my cooking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to choose ingredients suitable for the dishes you plan to make this month. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの食材は、汁物に加えてみるのはいかがですか。保存の案内などは、商品の表示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: How about adding this ingredient to soup? Please also check the product labeling for storage instructions and other information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 汁物に使う例を参考にします。表示で確かめる内容と、料理の提案を一つにせず、自分の作る量も考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 客観的表示と店員が教える料理例を分け一品の用途を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use the suggestion of adding it to soup as a reference. I will keep cooking suggestions separate from information to check on the label, and consider how much I will make.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate factual labeling from the staff member's cooking example and decide how to use the ingredient in a dish. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身の好みや、必要な量でお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please choose according to your own tastes and the amount you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は小さい物を一つにします。「旬」だけで必ず自分の好きな味だと決めず、家の料理に加えてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旬だけで品質や好みを保証されたとせず必要量を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will take one small one. I will try adding it to a meal at home without assuming that 'in season' guarantees a flavor I like.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the amount you need without treating 'in season' as a guarantee of quality or your personal taste. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの一つですね。それでは、お料理もお買物もお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: This one, then. Enjoy both your cooking and your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 花について、お尋ねになりたいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something you would like to ask about the flowers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここで良い香りがしました。この花の名前を知って、家でも同じ香りを楽しみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 良い香りをこの花と思い名称と家庭での楽しみを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I noticed a lovely scent here. I would like to know this flower's name so I can enjoy the same scent at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought the pleasant scent came from this flower and want to know its name and enjoy it at home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 花の案内はできますが、感じた香りがその花のものかは確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can tell you about the flowers, but have you confirmed that the scent you noticed comes from that flower?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。同行者の袋にも香りのある品物が入っているので、花だと決めつけたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者の袋も香りがあり発生元は未確認と認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. My companion also has something scented in their bag, so I may have assumed it was the flower.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that your companion's bag also contains a scented item and the source is unconfirmed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前の案内と、香りの発生元の確認は分けましょう。花をちぎって確かめないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us separate identifying the flower from checking the source of the scent. Please do not pick pieces off the flower to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ちぎりません。同行者に袋の中の物を聞いてから、花から香ったと言えるか考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 花をちぎらず同行者へ持参品を尋ねると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not. I will ask my companion what is in their bag before considering whether I can say the scent came from the flower.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not pick the flower and will ask your companion about what they brought. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの案内板で、この場所の花の名前は確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check the names of the flowers in this area on this information board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前だけ控えます。袋を花に近づけて混ぜた香りを比べても、どちらか分からなくなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名称のみ控え香りを混ぜるような比較を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will just note the name. Bringing the bag close to the flower to compare their mixed scents would probably make it impossible to tell which was which.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note only the name and avoid comparisons that mix the scents. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのままの状態でご覧ください。案内の中で分からない言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at the flowers as they are. Are there any words in the information you do not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前の読み方は分かりました。今日の香りの出所はまだ分けて確認し、花の名前と一緒に断定して伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 花名の読みを確認し香りの出所は未確認として残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand how to read the name. I will still check the source of today's scent separately and will not state it as certain along with the flower's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm how to read the flower's name while leaving the scent's source unconfirmed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご理解ありがとうございます。それでは、花をそのままお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for understanding. Please enjoy the flowers without disturbing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 購入機のご利用で、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble using the ticket machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の切符ではありません。隣のお客様から、画面を読んで買ってほしいと頼まれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 他客から購入画面の読取りと購入を頼まれたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is not my ticket. The customer beside me asked me to read the screen and buy one for them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that another customer asked you to read the purchase screen and buy a ticket. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お相手が何を買いたいか、確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked what that person wants to buy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 行先は聞きましたが、どの券を希望するかは分かりません。日本語を読めるからと、私が全部選んでよいとは思いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行先は聞いたが券種不明で本人が全選択できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have heard their destination, but I do not know which type of ticket they want. I do not think being able to read Japanese means I should make all the choices myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you know the destination but not the ticket type, so you cannot make every choice on their behalf. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その方のご希望は、係員がご本人から伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: A staff member will ask the person directly what they would like.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。財布も渡そうとされましたが、預かって支払うところまでは引き受けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 財布を預かる支払代行までは承諾していないと明かす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. They tried to hand me their wallet too, but I have not agreed to take it and make the payment for them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not agreed to take their wallet and pay on their behalf. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人が画面の前で待っていらっしゃるなら、こちらから伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: If they are waiting in front of the screen, we will go over to them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あちらにいます。私は「ここで係員に聞けます」と案内し、私が代わりに買ったという説明はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 依頼者の位置を示し係員相談へ案内すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: They are over there. I will tell them they can ask a staff member here, and will not say that I bought the ticket for them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point out where the person is and say you will direct them to consult a staff member. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 係員が伺うことをお伝えいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Could you tell them a staff member is coming?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 伝えました。お金や券を預からず、ご本人と係員に確認をお任せして、自分の用件に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 係員派遣を伝え金銭や券を預からず本人同士の確認へ戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have told them. I will leave it to them and the staff member to check the details, without taking any money or tickets, and return to my own business.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have told them a staff member is coming and will leave the checks to the people concerned without taking money or tickets. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お声がけありがとうございました。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの用紙は、ご本人が記入される物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this form meant to be filled in by the person concerned?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近所の人から、何に使う紙か聞いてきてほしいと頼まれました。中身はまだ何も書いてありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 近所の人に頼まれ未記入用紙の用途を聞きに来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: A neighbor asked me to find out what this form is used for. Nothing has been written on it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a neighbor asked you to come and ask the purpose of an unfilled form. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その方の手続きを代わりに進めるご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you wish to carry out that person's procedure on their behalf?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、使い道を聞くだけです。本人が申し込むと決めたわけでも、私が答える内容を頼まれたわけでもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 代理申請でなく用途質問のみで本人申込も未決定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I am only asking what it is for. They have not decided to apply, and they have not asked me to provide answers for them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are only asking the purpose, not making a proxy application, and the person has not decided to apply. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一般的な用紙の案内はできます。本人の事情に合わせた判断は、別に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can give general guidance about the form. A decision suited to the person's circumstances requires a separate check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 用紙の題名と説明を聞きたいです。知っている近所の事情から、私が欄を埋めることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一般的説明を希望し知人事情で欄を勝手に埋めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to hear the form's title and explanation. I will not fill in the fields myself based on what I know about my neighbor's circumstances.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a general explanation and say you will not fill in the fields without permission based on your acquaintance's circumstances. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この説明欄をご覧ください。ご本人が確認したい点も、窓口へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please look at this explanation section. The person can also consult the service counter about anything they wish to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明を持ち帰り、本人に見てもらいます。私の説明だけで申込みが済んだと思わせないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明を本人へ渡し窓口質問を申込み完了と誤解させない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take the explanation home and have them read it. I will make sure my explanation alone does not lead them to think the application is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Pass the explanation to the person and avoid giving the impression that asking at the counter completed the application. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人の相談方法は、この案内にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: This guide explains how the person can consult us directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内も渡します。近所の人の名前で回答するのではなく、用途の質問をしたことだけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の相談方法を渡し代わりに回答せず質問した範囲を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give them the guide too. I will only tell them that I asked what the form is for, rather than answering in my neighbor's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the person the consultation instructions and explain only what you asked, without answering on their behalf. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日は用紙のご案内までとします。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Today we will limit this to explaining the form. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 経過のメモの日付で、確認されたいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something you want to check about the date in your notes on how things developed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜勤の途中に体の変化に気づきました。昨日の勤務だから昨日のことと書きましたが、日付を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜勤中の変化を昨日とだけ言い日付を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I noticed a physical change partway through my night shift. I wrote that it happened yesterday because it was yesterday's shift, but I would like to check the date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you described a change during your night shift merely as happening yesterday and want to check the date. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務が始まった日と、気づいた時点は同じ日でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Was the day your shift began the same day you noticed the change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 始まったのは昨日の夕方です。気づいたときは休憩後で、携帯の日付はもう今日になっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務開始は前日だが気付いた時は日付が変わった後と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It began yesterday evening. I noticed the change after my break, and the date on my phone had already changed to today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the shift starting the previous day from noticing the change after the date had changed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いを担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please explain that distinction to the staff member responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝仕事が終わりました。仕事の前後という言い方だけで、一日全部を昨日として説明していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 退勤後も仕事前後だけで日付を判断しないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I finished work this morning. I had been describing the whole day as yesterday, using only whether something was before or after work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show that you understand not to determine the date solely by before or after work, even after finishing your shift. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かる範囲で、勤務開始と気づいた時点を分けてメモできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you note the shift's start and the time you noticed the change separately, as far as you know?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 勤務開始は昨日の夕方、気づいたのは日付が変わった後と分けます。正確な分は残していないので、今作って書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務開始時刻と変化のメモを別欄にし未記録分数を足さない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will separate the shift starting yesterday evening from noticing the change after the date had changed. I did not record the exact minutes, so I will not invent and write them now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Record the shift's start time and the change in separate fields, without adding minutes that were not recorded. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのメモを診察でお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show those notes at your medical consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 夜勤が日付をまたぐことを先に説明します。仕事の日の呼び名と、実際に気づいた日を一つにまとめないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当へ日付をまたぐ勤務と気付いた時点を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first explain that my night shift crosses midnight. I will avoid combining the name I use for the workday with the actual day I noticed the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Make clear to the staff member that the shift crossed midnight and when you noticed the change. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 夜勤の境目を整理したメモをお持ちください。それでは、診察のご案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring notes that clarify where the date changed during your night shift. Now please wait to be called for your consultation. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: かばんについて、ほかに確認できていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything else you have confirmed about the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近くに防犯の看板がありました。録画があるはずなので、誰が持ったかすぐ分かると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 防犯看板があり録画で持出者が分かると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was a security sign nearby. There should be a recording, so I think it will be clear straight away who took it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you saw a security sign and thought a recording would identify whoever took the bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 録画を実際に確認されたということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you mean you actually checked the recording?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、看板を見ただけです。カメラの位置も、その時間に記録していたかも知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実録画未確認で設備位置と稼働状況も知らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I only saw the sign. I do not know where the camera is or whether it was recording at that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not checked an actual recording and do not know the equipment's position or operating status. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 掲示を見たことと、録画の有無は分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will distinguish seeing the sign from whether a recording exists.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 看板の場所を伝えます。録画が残っていると店の人に聞いたわけではないことも説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 掲示位置のみ伝え店側の録画保有確認はないと明かす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will tell you where the sign was. I will also explain that I did not hear from the shop staff that a recording had been retained.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give only the sign's location and explain that the shop has not confirmed possession of a recording. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: かばんを最後に見た場所と、看板の場所は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Was the place you last saw the bag the same as the sign's location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少し離れています。看板が見えた範囲全部が映ると考えて、同じ場所とまとめていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: かばん最終目撃位置と離れた看板位置を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: They are a little apart. I assumed everything within sight of the sign would be filmed and treated them as the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the bag's last-seen position from the sign's separate location. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別々の位置として、ご自身で分かる範囲をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell us what you know yourself, treating them as separate locations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの場所を分けて示します。録画の確認方法は担当へ相談し、犯人が映っているという言い方はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 位置を分け録画確認を相談し犯人映像の存在を断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will indicate the two places separately. I will ask the staff member how recordings can be checked, and will not say there is footage of the culprit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the locations, ask about checking recordings and do not assert that footage of the culprit exists. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未確認の点を分けていただき、ありがとうございました。担当へご案内します。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for keeping the unconfirmed points separate. I will take you to the staff member responsible. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手紙の発送について、何を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to check about mailing your letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この封筒で案内を送ります。本文は短くして、日時などの大事な内容はQRコードから見てもらう予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重要な日時を紙本文でなくQR先へ置いて発送予定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will send an announcement in this envelope. I plan to keep the text short and have recipients view important details such as the date and time through a QR code.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you plan to mail a notice with the important date and time at the QR destination rather than in the paper text. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取る方が、その方法で内容を読めるかは確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked whether the recipient can read the contents that way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。携帯を持っていると聞いただけで、コードを読み取れると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取人の端末所持だけで読取可能と思い実確認はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I had only heard that they have a mobile phone, and assumed they could scan the code.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you assumed scanning was possible just because the recipient has a device, without actually checking. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送の受付では、リンク先を受取人が読めることまで確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: When accepting mail, we cannot check whether the recipient can read the linked page.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、読み取れなくても日時が分かるよう、紙の本文にも要点を書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: QR不可でも分かるよう紙にも要点を記載したいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I would like to put the key points in the paper text too, so they can see the date and time even if they cannot scan it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to include the key points on paper too so the notice is understandable without the QR code. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の案内の内容を整えてから、お出しいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can post it once you have organized the content of your notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話で受取人に確認します。リンクが開くかだけでなく、どこを見ると必要な内容が分かるかも説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取人へ表示可否と必要箇所の見方を直接確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check with the recipient by phone. I will explain not only whether the link opens, but where to look to find the information they need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check directly with the recipient whether the page displays and how to find the necessary part. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: このまま差し出されるか、準備してからにされるかお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please decide whether to post it as it is or prepare it further first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は持ち帰ります。紙の要点を足し、受取る人への確認をしてから、この案内を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日差出しを保留し紙補足と受取人確認を済ませて送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take it home today. I will add the key points on paper and check with the recipient before sending this notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Postpone mailing it today and send it after adding the paper explanation and checking with the recipient. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご準備後にお持ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring it back when you are ready. Goodbye.
